title: Intercepted enemy cipher letters summarised for Nevers, Sept-Oct 1589 (BnF fr. 3977 no. 96)

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3977 no. 96, fol. 318r-319r (canvas 520), ark btv1b9060546p
documents.route: intercepted League and Spanish traffic -> the duc de Nevers

plaintext.source: The piece is itself a clear digest of the interpreted letters; the ciphered originals are not in the volume.

transcription.source: Gallica IIIF, fr. 3977 canvas 520; points 1-9 transcribed in NOTES.md
transcription.notes: No ciphertext: every Sept-Oct 1589 piece in the volume (nos. 81, 84, 85, 89-97) is in clear.

system.summary: A clear French digest of intercepted cipher letters; the ciphertext it summarises does not survive in the volume.
system.notes: The same volume holds eleven other intercepted ciphered letters (Feb-Aug 1589, nos. 29, 31, 38, 39, 43-45, 47, 48, 49, 71) with contemporary interlinear decipherments; located, not transcribed.

prior_solution.where: BnF fr. 3977 no. 96 is the contemporary interpretation itself

conditions.human_role: External contributor (PR #9, Arya Sanketbhai Patel); the profile was written at merge time from nevers1589/NOTES.md.

solution.what: Parsed the BnF depouillement of fr. 3977 (138 pieces) and located no. 96 at fol. 318 = canvas 520.
Read no. 96: a clear French digest in fifteen points; points 1-9 transcribed.
Swept every Sept-Oct 1589 piece in the volume for the ciphered originals.

outcome.method_basis: BnF fr. 3977 no. 96 is the clear-French summary of the Sept-Oct 1589 intercepts; the ciphered letters themselves do not survive in the volume.
